label: prop:alpha-em-shift-multiplicative-chain
title: Multiplicative-chain form: $\alpha_{EM}^{-1} = q \cdot [\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9})]_q \cdot [\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5})]_q$
html:
Proposition. Multiplicative-chain form: \alpha_{EM}^{-1} = q \cdot [\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9})]_q \cdot [\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5})]_q

Proposition (multiplicative-chain form of \alpha_{EM}^{-1}). Let R = \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}, (q - q^{-1})^{-1}] be the base ring. Let q be the canonical substrate parameter. The inverse fine-structure constant admits the decomposition:

  \boxed{\;\;
    \alpha_{EM}^{-1}
    \;=\;
    q \cdot
    \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{2,9})\bigr]_q \cdot
    \bigl[\alpha_{\mathrm{shift}}(T_{3,5})\bigr]_q.
  \;\;}
